changed.meaning: Whether a legacy file was imported and unlinked.

signal.meaning: Success signal. Failures print caduceus-pjlink-catalog-import-failed: <underlying error> to stderr; underlying fixed errors include caduceus-pjlink-catalog-unreadable, caduceus-pjlink-catalog-lock-failed, caduceus-pjlink-catalog-changed, caduceus-pjlink-catalog-lock-poisoned, caduceus-pjlink-catalog-line-too-large, caduceus-pjlink-catalog-schema-desync, caduceus-pjlink-catalog-identity-missing and caduceus-pjlink-catalog-unlink-failed. Open forms include caduceus-pjlink-catalog-line-<line number>-invalid and <raw filesystem or SQLite error text>.

command.meaning: CLI command name printed on successful import.
